title: Could Steph Curry make a three over the Great Wall of China?
caption: Could Steph Curry hit a three over the Great Wall of China? We did the physics. The wall did not care. 🏀🧱 #could #stephcurry #greatwall #nba #basketball #physics #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Steph Curry make a three pointer over the Great Wall of China? {{ev}}We looked at the evidence. ||0.25|| {{sci}}Scientifically. ||0.3|| {{long}}With a protractor.

On offence: {{name}}Stephen Curry. {{h}}{1.88|One point eight eight} metres of point guard. {{rec}}The first player in history to make four thousand three pointers. {{arc}}His shot leaves the hand at about fifty two degrees. ||0.4|| {{walk}}He often turns around before it goes in.

On defence: {{name}}The Great Wall of China. {{h}}Up to seven metres tall. {{w}}Four to five metres thick. {{len}}{21,196|twenty one thousand, one hundred and ninety six} kilometres long. ||0.4|| {{def}}It has never conceded a basket.
Attempt one. {{t}}The normal shot. {{apex}}A regular Curry three peaks at about five metres. {{wall}}The wall is seven. ||0.5|| {{bonk}}The ball is returned to sender. ||0.4|| {{int}}With interest.

Attempt two. {{t}}The moonball. {{ang}}To clear the wall, the ball must leave his hand at seventy seven degrees, {{apex}}climbing over ten metres high. {{v}}Launch speed: forty six kilometres per hour. ||0.3|| {{bolt}}Faster than Usain Bolt. {{air}}Hang time: two and a half seconds. Double a normal three.

Attempt three. {{t}}The blind shot. {{see}}Curry can no longer see the rim. {{err}}One degree too steep, and he misses by half a metre. {{tol}}His margin of error: {0.2|zero point two} degrees. ||0.4|| {{miss}}Every miss lands in China. {{walk}}Walking around the wall to fetch it: eighty eight days.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Steph Curry make a three over the Great Wall? ||0.8|| {{yes}}Technically. ||0.6|| {{yes2}}Yes. {{prob}}Estimated chance per shot: two percent. ||0.3|| {{turn}}Chance he turns around before it lands: ||0.35|| {{p3}}one hundred.
